description: Estimates the construction cost of a new house or extension in South Africa from floor area, quality level and region, using rand-per-m² rates. Optionally adds professional fees and municipal plan fees as a percentage.

contingency_pct.description: Allowance for unforeseen costs, as % of the works. Default 10

double_storey.description: True for a double-storey build (adds about 8% to the rate). Default false

floor_area_m2.description: Gross floor area to build, in m²

include_vat.description: Add 15% VAT to the total. Default true

quality.description: Finish quality: economy, standard or premium. Default standard

region.description: Region id: cape-town, cape-winelands, west-coast, overberg, garden-route, johannesburg, pretoria, durban, gqeberha, bloemfontein or rural. Default cape-town

name: estimate_new_build
title: Estimate cost of building a new house or extension
